heading: EXT. PETTING ZOO - BIRTHDAY PARTY - DAY

units.text: EXT. PETTING ZOO - BIRTHDAY PARTY - DAY
Hay bales, a plywood barn, a paddock of goats in party hats.
Balloons bob from the fence.

HETTIE LOCKWOOD, eight, stands on a stool at the picnic table, chin on her fist, watching a goat eat a paper plate, while her father BOYD LOCKWOOD, forties, hurries from the cake table with a plastic knife and a stack of napkins, calling out to nobody that the candles need relighting, and trips over a feed bucket, and recovers, and laughs at himself a little too loudly.
Dad, he ate the plate.
units.name: HETTIE

units.text: He's a goat, honey. It's what they do.
units.name: BOYD

units.text: Mom said no one could come who we didn't invite.
units.name: HETTIE

units.text: Mom isn't here.
units.name: BOYD

units.text: He scrapes the cake into a pile and starts sticking candles in it.
Hettie looks past him, toward the gate, and goes very still.
A STRANGER in a rumpled linen suit and sunglasses stands at the entrance with a gift bag, scanning the crowd.
He lifts the glasses.
Waves at Hettie like he's known her all her life.
Hey, kiddo!
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Can I help you?
units.name: BOYD

units.text: It's Felix. Uncle Felix. Your brother, Boyd. Hello?
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Boyd stops with a candle in his fist.
The goat bleats.
Hettie hops off the stool and runs toward the gate, and Boyd, watching her go, drops the candle into the cake.
Felix.
units.name: BOYD

units.text: I brought a present.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Hettie hugs his leg.
Boyd stares at his brother's face for a long time, the whole party going quiet behind him, and then Boyd laughs again, but this time it cracks halfway.
You son of a-
units.name: BOYD

units.text: Dad! Language!
units.name: HETTIE
